scientific_integrity: Exact analytic local-in-strength theorem for a stable diagonal finite-dimensional continuous-time LQR plant; finite exact-rational checks are reproducibility aids only; earlier equivalent results and independent validation are not ruled out.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the mixed weak-channel coefficient at t=s=0, not to finite-strength global submodularity
Requires positive diagonal decay and identity state/input penalties and averaging covariance
Numerical checker is finite rather than an infinite-dimensional or all-parameter certificate
General Riccati perturbation theory may supply broader antecedents despite direct full-paper comparison
title: Modal isotropy is the sharp infinitesimal diminishing-returns boundary for LQR actuator additions
